from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionData(BaseModel):
    """One month of residential construction statistics reported in a single release."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data covers, format YYYY-MM")
    permits: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for total building permits")
    starts: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for total housing starts")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was issued, used to resolve conflicts via precedence rule")
    data_status: str | None = Field(description="Preliminary or revised status of the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_data: list[MonthlyConstructionData]
